title: DRR domain gap
summary: Calibrated separation tests of synthetic DRRs against real images: how far apart the two sets are.
does: tools/domain_gap.py: calibrated separation tests between a set of synthetic images and a set of real ones, with the replication test of FleXray's renderer, under the frozen docs/research/drr-domain-gap/PREREG.md. It trains no network on either set, so it reads no split part. Today it is three GPU jobs of the drr_gap flow, a prepare, a 16-task shard array and a merge (grid/gate.sh); the sandbox counts it inside the render job, with the merge's 4 hours.

outputs.name: metrics
outputs.what: The separation tests with their calibration.

nondeterminism: Its draws come from the study's salt (data/domain_gap/groups.json), so a rerun repeats them; a GPU's arithmetic may differ in its last bits.

generic.why: The tests compare 2-D images (tools/domain_gap.py); volumes would first need projecting.
